title: Public Service Act amended to allow full foreign ownership
description: Republic Act 11659 amended the 85-year-old Public Service Act, allowing 100% foreign ownership of public services including telecommunications, railways, airports and shipping. AmCham called it game-changing.
significance: Removed the 40% cap that had kept telecom-linked digital infrastructure in Filipino hands, opening the way for foreign-led networks and platforms.

title: Renewable energy opened to 100% foreign ownership
description: DOE Department Circular 2022-11-0034 amended the Renewable Energy Act rules so foreign investors can hold 100% of solar, wind, hydro and ocean projects, up from a 40% cap. Effective 8 Dec 2022.
significance: Lets foreign capital build the green power that data centre tenants want to buy.

title: US, Japan and Philippines launch the Luzon Economic Corridor
description: At a White House trilateral summit, Biden, Kishida and Marcos launched the first PGII corridor in the Indo-Pacific, linking Subic Bay, Clark, Manila and Batangas, with priorities in rail, ports, clean energy and semiconductor supply chains.
significance: Puts alliance money behind the same Subic-Clark-Manila-Batangas belt where data centre corridors are now being planned. Data centres are not named in the corridor itself.

title: Luzon grid on red alert with rotational brownouts
description: NGCP put the Luzon grid on red alert (2 to 4pm and 6 to 9pm) and yellow alert for other hours. 19 plants were on forced outage and 3 derated, leaving 13,537MW available against 13,024MW expected peak.
significance: Shows how thin Luzon's reserve margin is in the hot season, the core risk for any 24/7 data centre load.

title: First LNG cargo arrives as Malampaya declines
description: Linseed Field Power (an AG&P unit) received the country's first LNG cargo at its Batangas terminal in April 2023, from the UAE. First Gen's Batangas terminal followed in Aug 2023. DOE warns Malampaya gas could run dry by 2027.
significance: Gas power now depends on imported LNG priced on world markets, raising cost and supply risk.

title: CREATE MORE Act names data centres a top-tier incentive activity
description: RA 12066 (effective 28 Nov 2024) raised the extra deduction on power expenses from 50% to 100% for registered enterprises, set a 20% corporate tax under the enhanced deductions regime, and lists data-centre facilities, AI and cybersecurity among Tier III priority activities.
significance: Directly targets the biggest data centre operating cost, electricity, in a country with some of ASEAN's highest power prices.

title: Huawei Cloud launches a three-zone Philippines Region
description: Huawei Cloud launched its Philippines Region in Manila, billed as the country's first local 3-availability-zone public cloud, with 100+ services and 300+ local customers. DCD reports Digital Halo, VITRO and STT GDC posted about involvement.
significance: A Chinese hyperscaler beat the US big three to a full in-country cloud region, inside a US treaty ally.

title: US AI Diffusion Rule leaves the Philippines in Tier 2
description: The Biden-era AI Diffusion Rule put 18 close allies in Tier 1, arms-embargoed states in Tier 3 and most others, including the Philippines, in Tier 2 with compute caps. It was rescinded in May 2025 before caps applied.
significance: Even a treaty ally was not on the trusted list, a reminder that chip access is a policy lever.

title: Trump sets 19% tariff on Philippine goods after Marcos visit
description: After Marcos's White House visit, Trump announced a 19% tariff on Philippine imports, up from the April 17% rate but below a threatened 20%. Marcos called the US the country's 'strongest, closest, most reliable ally'.
significance: Alliance did not buy a tariff discount versus Indonesia (19%) or Vietnam (20%).

title: Equinix enters the Philippines by buying three Manila data centres
description: Equinix completed its acquisition of TIM's MN1, MN2 and MN3 in Manila, with 1,000+ cabinets and land to expand. Price not disclosed.
significance: The first big US colocation brand arrived by buying local capacity rather than building.

title: VITRO Santa Rosa opens as the first AI-ready hyperscale site
description: PLDT's VITRO launched its 50MW, 4,500-rack Santa Rosa data centre, hosting the country's first NVIDIA-powered GPU servers for ePLDT's AI Stack.
significance: The country's largest operating site, and its first NVIDIA AI cluster, built by the incumbent telco.

title: Konektadong Pinoy Act lapses into law
description: The act removes the congressional franchise requirement for data transmission providers, replacing it with DICT registration, and lets them use satellite capacity directly. DICT may set rules to safeguard local data for national security.
significance: With RA 11659, removes the main legal barriers to foreign entry into data transmission, making fibre and backhaul for data centres easier to build.

title: DAMAC Digital plans up to 250MW in Laguna
description: During Marcos's UAE visit, Dubai's DAMAC Digital presented a plan for a data centre of up to 250MW in Laguna that could become the country's largest. Malacanang promised priority treatment. No dollar figure for the Philippine project.
significance: Gulf capital becomes a new source of hyperscale ambition alongside US and Singapore players.

title: G42 eyes a Philippine data centre
description: DICT Secretary Henry Aguda said Abu Dhabi's G42 is eyeing a Philippine data centre but must still check land, power, water and connectivity. DICT later cited up to US$500m.
significance: Adds the UAE's US-aligned AI champion to the list of prospective hosts, still at an early stage.

title: KKR and Singtel agree to buy full control of STT GDC
description: A KKR-led consortium with Singtel agreed to buy the remaining 82% of STT GDC for S$6.6bn (US$5.1bn), KKR 75% and Singtel 25% after completion. STT GDC co-owns STT GDC Philippines with Globe and Ayala. Pulse 2.0 (2 Sep 2026) reports completion.
significance: Puts a US private equity owner behind the operator of the country's largest campus, STT Fairview.

title: US Supreme Court strikes down IEEPA tariffs; 10% then 15% global levy follows
description: The court ruled 6-3 that reciprocal tariffs needed Congress, voiding the 19% Philippine rate. Trump replaced it with a Section 122 levy of 10%, raised to 15% from 24 Feb, capped at 150 days unless Congress extends it.
significance: Tariff risk for Philippine exports fell but stayed uncertain; electronics (53% of US-bound exports) were largely shielded before.

title: DICT sets an 18GW data centre ambition
description: DICT Secretary Aguda outlined 18GW of data centre capacity over the next decade, against nearly 500MW now (DCPH members), with 1.5GW more expected by end-2027 and a study on converting the mothballed Bataan Nuclear Power Plant into a data centre of up to 600MW.
significance: A very large target relative to a grid that already sees red alerts; treat as aspiration.

title: Converge opens 12MW AI-ready Angeles data centre
description: Converge ICT inaugurated a 12MW AI-ready facility in Angeles City, Pampanga, built for nearly P5bn and scalable to 36MW or more. Converge's total data centre capacity is about 20MW.
significance: Moves capacity north into the Clark corridor that the government and the US-led Pax Silica plan now favour.

title: STT GDC Philippines signs 10-year Meralco MPower renewables deal
description: STT GDC Philippines signed a 10-year deal with MPower, Meralco's retail supply arm, for 40.5MW of renewable energy for STT Fairview and STT Cavite. Its seven sites total 150MW IT load.
significance: Shows how operators source green power through Meralco's retail arm rather than building their own plants.

title: US-led Pax Silica tech hub proposed for New Clark City
description: A US-led Pax Silica hub for chips, AI and rare earths is proposed at New Clark City on former US base land. Backers claim 200,000 jobs and up to US$70bn. Marcos calls it practical, not political; Senator Tulfo filed a resolution to probe land, water and indigenous impacts.
significance: The clearest sign the alliance is turning into a tech supply-chain bet, and a target for Chinese pressure.

title: Government unveils US$34.4bn AI infrastructure masterplan
description: The Philippines AI+ Infrastructure Masterplan 2026-2033 targets 1.5GW of AI data centre capacity by 2033 (about 400MW by 2030) from a 50MW AI baseline, with Clark-Bataan as the primary corridor and 40% renewable power by 2033.
significance: Turns scattered ambitions into a corridor plan centred on Clark and Batangas.

title: VITRO REIT and Meralco PowerGen sign power-integrated data centre MOU
description: VITRO REIT and Meralco PowerGen (MGEN) signed an MOU for a feasibility study on data centres integrated with power generation; MGEN will identify sites and supply options. VITRO's proposed REIT holds eight data centres totalling 27MW.
significance: Moves toward co-locating data centres with dedicated generation, a hedge against grid shortfalls.
